title: Competition for attention predicts good-to-bad tipping in AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to specific prompts (e.g., 'Are men smarter than women?') by coarse-graining outputs into desirable and undesirable conceptual basins and measuring the dot-product competition for attention to predict when the model tips into generating biased text.

Analyzing generated continuations for prompts targeting specific professions and institutions (e.g., 'Are scientists arrogant?', 'Are politicians bad?', 'Is Nature a biased journal?') using geometric projection of token embeddings into predefined 'good' and 'bad' concept centroids.
